name: SurveySparrow
description: SurveySparrow is a versatile survey platform that allows users to create engaging and interactive surveys. It offers a range of features to design, distribute, and analyze surveys, making it ideal for gathering feedback and insights from various audiences.

events.d: Create a contact using an Email, Phone, Mobile, or Unique ID; optionally add full name, job title, contact type, reference ID, list memberships, custom fields, and subscription/unsubscribe settings.
Update an existing contact by email or contact ID. Modify name, email, phone, mobile, job title, unique or reference IDs, unsubscribe status/text, and custom fields.
Deletes a contact from SurveySparrow using the provided email address.
Find a contact by its email id.
Find the details of existing user by its email address.
Delete a user identified by their user ID.
Creates a new contact list.
Update a contact list using its name.
Find the details of an existing contact list by its name.
Delete an existing contact list by its name.
Creates a new contact property
Update the details of existing contact property by its label.
Delete an existing contact property by its label.
Triggers when a new contact is created.
Triggers when a new user is created.
Triggers when a new contact list is created.
Triggers when a new contact property is created.
Create new team.
Triggers when a new team is created.
Create a new survey with the specified name and survey type and return the survey's details.
Triggers when a new survey folder is created.
Creates a survey folder.
Triggers when a new survey is created.
Update an existing survey's name using its Survey ID.
Search a contact property by its label or id.
Rename a survey folder and update its visibility (All or Private) using the folder's current name or ID.
Delete a survey folder by name and return a confirmation or not-found message.
Email a survey to one or more recipients now, on a specific date, after a set number of days, or on a recurring schedule.
